messages.subject: Lyra – MSSA drafting plan
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Can you take first pass on the SOW-1, SLA schedule and DPA while I draft the body of the MSSA? Key commercials are locked in the heads of terms. Watch the M&V methodology in SOW-1 — it drives the 18% shared-savings fee, so it needs to be tight. Target first full draft to the client by 7 October.

Thanks,
James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
